Convert movement-kernel coefficients to another density measure

Source: R/data.R
convert_movement_coefficients.Rd

A radial-angle density equals the planar density multiplied by r, so its log_step coefficient is larger by one. All other coefficients are unchanged. This conversion preserves the underlying spatial model when proposal densities are also converted with convert_density_measure().

Usage

convert_movement_coefficients(coefficients, from, to)

Arguments

coefficients

Numeric coefficient matrix with a unique log_step row.

from, to

Source and target measures, "area" or "step_angle".

Value

A coefficient matrix in the target measure.
